NaN_Inf: Frozen contract only; no new imputation
repeatability: Two independent future replays on identical frozen inputs; compare schema/order/values using predeclared serialization

serialization.dense: ASCII E1R2_ROW_V1 + NUL + D; uint64_le column_count; contiguous float64_le values
serialization.json: UTF8; sorted keys; ensure_ascii=true; compact comma/colon separators; allow_nan=false; one LF
serialization.shape: One scientific row (1,column_count); no matrix row ordinal in value digest
serialization.sparse: ASCII E1R2_ROW_V1 + NUL + S; uint64_le column_count,nnz; sorted uint64_le indices; paired float64_le values
serialization.sparse_order: Sort index-value pairs ascending by index; reject duplicates; preserve explicit zeros
serialization.strings: Exact Unicode strings, no trimming, case folding, Unicode normalization or SHA expansion
serialization.utf8: Strict UTF8 for text digests; invalid strings rejected

validation_target: Frozen prospective reconstruction contract and exact intended predictor-input semantics
